text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,960.6, up 0.63% on the day and 5.56% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.1% (5‑day gain 4.79%). Advances outpaced declines (404 vs 87) giving a breadth score of 60.3, which the system labels “HEALTHY”. Both major indices showed strength above their 20‑day moving average (65.4% of stocks) and the market’s volatility index (India VIX) fell to 15.19, down 3.37%‑5‑day ‑6.52%, indicating calmer trading.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 14,974.68 crore today and a 5‑day total of INR 35,808.74 crore, extending a 7‑day buying streak. Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 10,444.54 crore, a 5‑day net of INR ‑19,045.33 crore. Leading sectors were Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Pharma and FMCG, while IT and Private Bank stocks showed weakening. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.34 for Nifty, a “max‑pain” level near 24,350 and a call wall at 25,000, suggesting resistance around that point.

Watch the Nifty 50 pivot levels: support at 23,784.3, pivot at 23,872.45 and resistance at 24,048.75. A break above the call wall (25,000) could push the market toward the expected range top of 24,814.29. Keep an eye on the RBI’s upcoming variable‑rate repo auction (Nov 9) and any news on the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO, as both could influence liquidity and sentiment in the next session.
